title: What It Really Costs to Own a DeLorean Today
description:
A DeLorean DMC-12 launched at twenty-five thousand dollars. In twenty twenty-six, one source puts the benchmark price of an automatic at fifty-nine thousand, forty-nine dollars. But what does it really cost to own one? The purchase is only the first bill. In this video we add up fuel, parts, repairs and storage using published numbers, and we flag every place where the sources go quiet. Our sources are ThePricer, Classic and Sports Car, Classics World, Petrolicious, Wikipedia pages on the car and on the Texas company, the Classic DMC store, and the Energy Information Administration. Some figures are in pounds, some in dollars, and some are years old. We keep currencies separate. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
